FN-MUYXHW1-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 137
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Representative Rex Reynolds
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/07/2025
House Bill 137 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of any contract entered for
interpretive services for monitoring certain communications during an investigation as provided
by this bill.
Page 1
